description: Overnight heart-rate variability per night over a date range, for trends: last-night average, 5-minute high, 7-day average, personal baseline range and HRV status (BALANCED, UNBALANCED, LOW, POOR), plus average / min / max in `summary`. Keyed by the wake-up date; HRV in milliseconds (RMSSD). Defaults to the last 7 nights; at most 92 nights per call. For one night with overnight readings use garmin_get_hrv.

end_date.description: Last day (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today, or 6 days after start_date (not past today).

start_date.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD in the user's time zone. Default: 6 days before end_date. At most 92 days per call.

name: garmin_get_hrv_summaries
title: Get Garmin HRV summaries
